common_name: Hawaiian Hammerhead Stalk-Eyed Picture-Wing Fly (Broad Hypercephalic Head Capsule)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila heteroneura (5.2 µm, detail scale)

paleobiology.chronoseries_note: Neighbors in the Delphi Drosophila chronoseries at 0 Ma. Not a stratigraphic ancestor-descendant chain. Guttifera is a picture-wing-adjacent Wingless spot model; hydei is a repleta-group fly. Both are extant.

equations.activator: du/dt = Du * laplacian(u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 v)
equations.inhibitor: dv/dt = Dv * laplacian(v) + gamma * (b - u^2 v)

specimen.license_note: Vendored from the project species gallery after Wikimedia Commons returned no bitmap for this taxon in the slot-3188 scout.

reported_in_source: Turing 1952 dispersion relation for a two-species reaction-diffusion system
Spieth 1981: D. heteroneura males differ from D. silvestris in head shape
Werner et al. 2010: D. guttifera wing spots are Wingless-induced yellow melanin
Pitnick et al. 1995: D. hydei produces giant sperm; a repleta-group fly
reconstructed_in_script: gamma and Dv/Du chosen so the critical wavelength is 5.222 µm
neighbor gammas set so lambda scales as gamma^{-1/2} to 8.400 µm and 6.350 µm
male head width 1.72 mm used only to count modes
radial Fourier envelope fitted to the gallery micrograph
does_not_claim: That guttifera or hydei is a literal ancestor of heteroneura
That the gallery micrograph's ~68 µm rings are the 5.222 µm critical mode
That the kinetic constants were measured in a heteroneura pigment assay
